Close shot of the station housing by a creek, with the battery meter full green and a 'Charges from light' callout. At 13.6 s it cuts to a wide shot: the pole stands in a brown flooded road, with the skyline and a lattice tower behind.
A dashed line from the antenna stops short with break marks. A 'No cell tower needed' tag points at the lattice tower. The skyline is visible and the flooded road fills the lower frame. Static hold.

Wide station hold to 15.6 s. At 15.8 s it cuts to a close shot of the pole: three dark pods above a brown waterline, a yellow-lit pod at the waterline, and reflections below. The skyline sits behind the trees.

Pole close shot. A 'Four optical sensors' tag pins at 16.2 to 16.6 s. Three pods sit above the water and one lit pod at the waterline. The water is a flat brown-gray surface with reflections. The caption sits below the pods.
The waterline rises over the pods in turn. Submerged pods glow yellow and blur under the surface (17.2 to 17.8 s), and by 17.8 s the top pod is lit at the waterline.

The water covers all pods, leaving four yellow glows under the surface at 18.0 to 18.2 s. At 18.4 s it cuts to the housing close shot. Rain, Temperature and Humidity labels pin in turn at 18.6 to 18.8 s.

Rain, Temperature, Humidity and Light labels on the housing, and the caption clears at 19.2 s. At 19.8 s it cuts to the opened box on the pole: TinyML chip on a green board, and a Flood risk bar with one green segment.
Static opened box on the pole, chip unlit, Flood risk bar at one segment, 'Illustration. Not real hardware' chip shown. Nothing moves.
Box static until 21.8 s, when pulse dots appear on the traces and the chip outline begins to glow.
Pulses travel along the traces into the TinyML chip at 22.0 to 22.2 s. The chip outline glows yellow from 22.4 s and holds.
Glowing chip held. The caption clears at 23.2 s. A push-in starts at 23.8 s with the central-server caption.
Push-in on the board. The lamp turns amber at 24.6 s and the risk bar fills to three colored segments. The 'Judged on the station' tag pins at 24.8 s.
Risk bar at four segments with the amber lamp lit. At 25.4 s it cuts to a wide shot: station at right in brown floodwater, a dark server building at left, skyline behind.
A dashed line from the station housing toward the 'Central server' building stops short with break marks. Floodwater with reflections fills the lower frame. Static after 26.2 s.

At 27.2 s it cuts to a bungalow street flooded to the doorsteps, station at left and a hub with a mast at the street end. Yellow rings start at the antenna at 27.6 to 27.8 s and spread across the street.
Rings travel down the flooded street toward the far hub, shrinking in perspective. The caption covers the mid-street.
Rings reach the street end. A scale line and the 'More than a half-mile' tag pin at 29.2 to 29.8 s, and the hub lamp lights.
Static hold of the street with the half-mile tag, scale line and lit hub. The caption clears at 30.8 s.
At 31.2 s it cuts to an open grass field with a hub building, mast and fence, and no skyline. A 'Station' inset at upper left emits arcs from 31.6 s.
Arcs expand from the station inset across the sky toward the mast. The 'Up to five miles in open country' tag pins at 32.8 s.
Arcs reach the mast, whose tip glows at 33.2 s, and the hub window lights. No skyline in the frame.
Hold with the mast and hub window lit and the tag pinned. The caption clears at 34.8 s.
Field hold, then at 35.4 s a cut to the hub room: a seated responder in navy at a desk faces a 'Flood path map' monitor with a creek and street grid; mug, keyboard, drawers and bin.
An 'A second, larger model' tag pins. Dots light along the creek. The responder's arm reaches the keyboard; the hands are small rough shapes.
The responder's head turns toward the map at 37.2 s. Otherwise a static desk scene with tags.
Push to a full-frame Flood path map at 38.2 s. Orange paths spread along the creek and branch streets at 38.6 to 38.8 s. The lower 40 percent of the frame is a blank beige wall.
Paths complete. A 'Higher risk' legend, dashed amber zones and a 'For emergency responders' tag appear at 39.6 to 39.8 s.
Static map with the lower frame blank beige. The caption clears at 40.4 s.

A cork notice board on posts at a curb, with a 'Validation accuracy' card showing an empty bar and 'Reported by the university'. Creek, grass and flooded road behind. The disclosure chip sits above the card.
The board is static until the bar-fill marker starts at 42.6 to 42.8 s.
'98.82%' appears and the orange bar fills by 43.4 to 43.6 s. The full figure, heading and source line are readable inside the frame.
Static card showing the whole '98.82%' and the heading. The caption clears at 44.6 s.

Push-in from 45.0 s. The card's left edge stays inside the frame, '98.82%' is whole with its 9, and the heading is readable. The disclosure chip sits just above the heading and touches the card's top corner without covering the words.
The whole '98.82%' card is held. The 'Initial assessments after training' tag pins at 46.4 to 46.8 s and is fully inside the frame and readable.
Static hold: the whole 98.82% card and the full assessments tag over the creek view.
A blank 'Field result' card slides in at the right at 48.0 to 48.2 s and is cut by the right frame edge. 98.82% and the tag stay whole.
Pull-back at 49.2 s: both cards whole, the smaller 98.82% card and tag at left, the blank Field result card at right. The disclosure now reads 'Not a real report or map'.
A stamp held by a forearm descends from the top at 50.0 to 50.4 s and presses 'None reported' at 50.6 s. 'None reported' prints fully on the Field result card at 50.8 s.
The stamp lifts out at 51.0 s. Both cards are whole with 'None reported' fully printed; static hold from 51.2 to 51.8 s.
The cards hold at 52.0 s, then a cut to a chain-link fence with the skyline behind. A paper map with a creek line appears pinned to the fence at 52.8 s.
A forearm enters from the right and its finger slides along the map's creek at 53.2 to 53.6 s, then lifts toward the upper map at 53.8 s. The hand is a rough shape.
The hand leaves by 54.2 s. A dark 'Announcement names no installation' tag pins at the top right of the map at 54.4 to 54.6 s.

Map hold, then at 55.6 s a cut to a curb folding table: a technician holds a 'Deployment plan' sheet beside a dark carry case and a small station prototype. The disclosure reads 'Illustration. Announcement names no installation'. A flooded road fills the foreground.
The technician folds the plan and tucks it into the case pocket at 56.0 to 56.4 s, then presses the case at 56.6 to 56.8 s. The hands are rough shapes.
A 'Deployment goal' tag pins at 57.2 s. The case stays on the table with the technician's hands resting on and beside it; no lift. The caption clears at 57.4 s.
Static closing hold: technician standing behind the closed case on the table, Deployment goal tag, prototype at right, flooded road in the foreground.
